title: Games
description: Every game of the app, declared as data: the design notes the code must agree with. scaffold-game.mjs writes an entry per new game; check-game-scaffold.mjs holds the game folder, the catalogs, the loaded game module and (when multi-package) the game's own app to it.

id.description: kebab-case and permanent: the folder <gamesDir>/<id>, identity.id, the catalog namespace <id>. and the key of every saved run.

name.description: The display name in the source language (<id>.name).

class.description: How the game runs: turn by turn, simulate-then-replay, or real time (a sim/ folder).

panMode.description: The pan gesture the board turns into intents (GameInput.panMode).

levels.description: null for a game without level packs (a daily- or endless-only game too); else the pack layout of the shipped level tables, which must equal the game's packCount and levelsPerPack in contracts/levels.json (level-generation-and-solvers).

daily.description: The levels spec has a daily level (equal to daily in contracts/levels.json when the game has packs).

endless.description: The levels spec has an endless run (difficulty 100, never won; equal to endless in contracts/levels.json when the game has packs).

hints.description: GameRules.hints.kind: solver only when a solver proves the next move.

continue.description: GameRules.continueRun.kind: once when a lost run may continue one time.

loseReasons.description: Every way of losing, one <id>.lose.<reason> catalog key each; [] for a game that cannot be lost.

app.description: When multi-package: the game's own app folder (apps/<id>).

apps.description: When multi-package (one game = one white-label app): the facts every app shares.

scope.description: The npm scope of the app packages (@acme).

bundlePrefix.description: Every app's iOS bundle id and Android package is <bundlePrefix>.<id without hyphens>.

locales.description: The apps' language tags; every app has one catalog per tag.

composer.description: The shared function app.config.ts calls with the app's settings and process.env.

fontsDir.description: The shared font files and licence texts every app bundles byte for byte.

adUnits.description: null for apps without ads; else the ad unit names each app has ids for.
